sections.title: Section A: Calculations and Procedures
sections.instructions: Answer all questions in this section. Show all working steps where required. Marks are awarded for correct methods and accurate answers.

memo: Award 1 mark for correct method (showing carrying), 1 mark for correct answer

memo: Award 1 mark for correct method, 1 mark for correct answer
